# M5 benchmark summary (machine-generated by backend/eval/metrics.py)

**H** (headline, DESIGN A21) = last voiced input frame -> first audio of the LAST sentence (browser clock): the measured first audible sample, or on a split cascade turn (earlier segment held until the commit, D8) the final segment's tail estimate when that is later. The harness releases PTT 450 ms after the last voiced frame (DESIGN A2), so **H−gap** removes that fixed release gap. Tail = cascade server estimate for the final segment's first audio (excludes network/playout). **First audible¹** = the literal first audible sample of the turn (on split turns, the held first sentence).
